cd /tmp && cat > y.py <<'EOF'
import numpy as np, math
from PIL import Image
im=np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0118.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)
R,G,B=im[:,:,0],im[:,:,1],im[:,:,2]
cx,cy,h=0.649,1.051,-30.0
hr=math.radians(h); F=(math.sin(hr),math.cos(hr)); Rt=(math.cos(hr),-math.sin(hr))
def bp(u,v,z=0.0):
    D=(1.55-z)*256./(v-256.); L=D*(u-256)/256.
    return round(cx+D*F[0]+L*Rt[0],3), round(cy+D*F[1]+L*Rt[1],3), round(D,2)
# chair: mid brown
ch=(R>90)&(R<160)&((R-B)>45)&(G<R-30)
ys,xs=np.nonzero(ch[:, :230]); print('chair n',len(xs),'u',xs.min(),xs.max(),'v',ys.min(),ys.max())
print('  legs: per-col bottom')
for u in range(95,185,5):
    c=np.nonzero(ch[:,u])[0]
    if len(c)>3: print('  u',u,'top',c.min(),'bot',c.max(),bp(u,c.max()))
# lamp base dark disc
lb=(R>55)&(R<105)&(abs(R-G)<14)&(abs(G-B)<18)&(B>=R-5)
ys,xs=np.nonzero(lb[:,215:275])
if len(xs): print('lampbase n',len(xs),'u',xs.min()+215,xs.max()+215,'v',ys.min(),ys.max(),'gnd',bp(int(xs.mean())+215,ys.max()))
# stool legs
st=(R>60)&(R<130)&(abs(R-G)<25)&(B>R-20)
ys,xs=np.nonzero(st[:,280:340])
if len(xs): print('stool n',len(xs),'u',xs.min()+280,xs.max()+280,'v',ys.min(),ys.max(),'gnd',bp(int(xs.mean())+280,ys.max()))
# white wall base -> resection
w=(R>245)&(G>245)&(B>240)
print('--- wall base')
for u in range(0,512,20):
    c=np.nonzero(w[:,u])[0]
    if len(c)>5 and c.max()>258: print(u,c.max())
EOF
python3 y.py 2>/dev/null
